A_raw.valid_bits: bits0..3 per channel; EM bits0..2 must all be 0 or all be 1
A_raw.saturation_bits: bits4..7; saturation requires valid; saturated EM is a clipped endpoint, but endpoint alone need not imply saturation
A_raw.hold_bits: bits8..10 all set iff original valid EM tick is earlier than ADC tick; bit11 must be zero for vibration
A_raw.source_fault_bit: bit12 iff all EM invalid in this candidate; vibration may remain valid
A_raw.upper_quality_bits: bits13..15 zero on raw candidate record; do not graft UART grant semantics into it
A_raw.invalid_channel: value=null, count=null, saturation and hold cleared; no zero filling
A_raw.invalid_EM: em_tick_ms=null, first3 values/counts null; may coexist with valid vibration
A_raw.count_zero: A valid low-endpoint quantized value, not a missing sentinel
A_raw.vibration_startup_or_gap: invalid until ten observed contiguous ADC slots; SourceLedger requires the claimed valid bit to agree exactly with its received history
A_raw.vibration_saturation: any clipped sample in the ten-sample window; RMS may be below2g, but saturated valid RMS must be >=sqrt(0.4)g

quality_missing_hold_saturation.summary_flags: valid0-3, saturated4-7, held8-11, source_fault12; grants13-15 scheduling only, never validity or authorization
quality_missing_hold_saturation.summary_fresh_mask: valid && !saturated && !held && !source_fault && age<=caller_limit; grants never validate or authorize
quality_missing_hold_saturation.summary_mask0_numerics: Existing source retains normalized means/ranges for nonpadding invalid/held/sat/fault/stale columns. Only cold-start padding is numeric0+mask0.
quality_missing_hold_saturation.source_fault_semantic_gap: A bit12 means three EM invalid; vibration can remain valid. Existing summary source applies global fault to all four masks. Blind flag copying changes vibration eligibility; A decision required.
quality_missing_hold_saturation.null_to_summary_gap: A missing scalar/count is null. Existing raw16 summary requires finite mean/range even when mask0; no approved representation/conversion. Do not fill raw null with0.
quality_missing_hold_saturation.held_causality_gap: A held valid EM carries original50ms acquisition tick while ADC advances10ms. Summary raw16 has one last-included acquisition tick and source_native_tick_ms=None. Do not count held EM as new independent acquisition or replace original time with receipt.

clock_run_history.source_time: Trusted caller origin maps tick via origin_ns+(tick-start_tick_ms)*1000000; strict increasing10ms ADC, native50ms EM, full history from origin, no backfill.
clock_run_history.clock_highwater: Trusted nondecreasing receiver time is observed before untrusted parsing; rejected payload may advance clock but no sample/heartbeat state.
clock_run_history.source_health: Mapped ADC and originalEM not future and age<=100ms; healthy requires receipt/originalEM age<=100ms. Holds never renew original deadline; no actuator watchdog implemented.
clock_run_history.gap_recovery: ADC gap resets observed vibration window. Producer valid RMS may reject after transport loss; no invented missed rows or undocumented resync.
